name: Triffle Crennel Windis
original_name: トリフィル・クレンネル・ウィンディス
source:
Prince of the 'Wind Country Windis'.
He was chosen to pour power into the 'magic stone'.
A quiet and serious person, while being a prince he is also a leading member of his countries knight troupe, he's quite proficient with a sword.
A while back when he decided to become a knight the prince of the Flower Country, Spinel was against it and ever since the two haven't got along.
He's friendly with [url=/c46510]Yukeles[/url].
